instruction: Use Arial font throughout. Set background to #F5F5F5, text ink to #333333, and accent to #0055A4. Employ generous white space with left-aligned text blocks and thin rectangular dividers. Titles should be large and uppercase. Use simple bar charts with solid fills. Maintain a clean, corporate hierarchy with minimal decorative elements for a professional look.
checks: High contrast between dark text and light background with blue accents
Sans-serif font with left-aligned text and rectangular dividers

instruction: Select Calibri font for all elements. Background must be #1A1A1A, body text #E0E0E0, and accent #00FF99. Arrange content in grid-like structures using sharp rectangles and straight lines. Display data via native tables or line charts. Ensure high contrast between the dark background and bright neon green accents to evoke a modern, digital system aesthetic without curved connectors.
checks: Bright neon green accents stand out against dark background
Sans-serif font arranged in grid with sharp rectangles

instruction: Utilize Georgia font to create a narrative feel. Background should be #FFF8E7, ink #4A3B2A, and accent #C45B3A. Compose slides with centered headings and left-aligned body text blocks. Use soft rectangular shapes behind key points. Charts should use standard bars. The overall composition should resemble a magazine layout with warm, earthy tones and readable serif typography.
checks: Rust colored accents visible against cream background
Serif font with centered headings and rectangular shapes

instruction: Apply Arial font strictly. Set background to #FFFFFF, text to #000000, and accent to #808080. Focus on dense information density using structured tables and multi-series category charts. Align all elements to a strict baseline grid. Use grayscale rectangles for emphasis without color distraction. The style must appear scholarly, relying on weight and spacing rather than hue for visual hierarchy.
checks: Background is white or very light gray
Grayscale accents used alongside black text
Sans-serif font with dense tables and aligned grids

instruction: Choose Calibri font with heavy weights. Background is #0B0C15, primary text #FFFFFF, and accent #FFD700. Create dynamic compositions using oversized bold titles and staggered rectangular accents. Connectors should be thick and straight. Data visualization must use high-contrast solid bars. The layout should feel energetic and impactful, utilizing negative space to highlight key messaging and vibrant yellow accents.
checks: Background is very dark near-black tone
Gold yellow accents provide strong contrast
Sans-serif font with oversized titles and straight lines

instruction: Use Arial font with clean styling. Background is #E3F2FD, ink #263238, and accent #FF7043. Arrange elements in loose clusters rather than rigid grids. Use rounded rectangles and straight lines. Charts should have distinct labels and friendly colors. The composition should feel approachable and collaborative, avoiding sharp angles in favor of inviting, open spatial arrangements.
checks: Orange accents stand out against blue background
Sans-serif font with rounded rectangles and loose clusters
